OO-OO-ORG-500.name: Nonna's Olive Oil (500mL Original)
OO-OO-ORG-500.note: The sole SKU selling from inception through 2026-08-13 - every unit/revenue figure dated before OO-OO-ORG-501's 2026-08-14 launch is entirely this one. No explicit active_since (treated as always-active) since its exact original launch date isn't independently verified.

OO-OO-ORG-501.name: Nonna's Olive Oil (500mL Original) - 3-Pack
OO-OO-ORG-501.note: First real order confirmed live 2026-08-14 (Amazon). active_since must stay in sync with reality - see sku_financials.py's sole_active_sku_as_of for why this date matters beyond documentation. pack_size=3 means each Shopify line-item quantity is 3 real bottles, not 1 - see handlers.get_sku_units_live's docstring.
